subject: ShinyMap: map displays but out of focus

messages.author: 40628c22eff95227
messages.subject: ShinyMap: map displays but out of focus
parts:
I'm able to display locations of interest, using ShinyMap, based on latitude/longitude in the north american region. However, when it loads up, it's completely out of focus.
For example, it defaults to say European region instead of North America. I have to manually zoom in for my point of interest to show up.
Does anyone have an idea where I need to modify the setting so it defaults and zooms corrects for North America?

In my UI.R file I have something like this ... could this be where the map display is being controlled? Will appreciate any input or suggestions

leafletMap(
        "map", "100%", "100%",
         initialTileLayer = "<reference-to-an-image>.png",
         initialTileLayerAttribution = HTML('Tiles © <a href="", target="_blank">Stamen Design</a> (<a href="http://<some-web-address>", target="_blank">CC BY 3.0</a>), Map data © <a href="http://<some-web-address>",        
         target="_blank">OpenStreetMap</a> (<a href="http://<some-web-address>", target="_blank">CC BY SA</a>)'),
         options=list( center = c(30.45, 128), zoom = 4, maxBounds = list(list(17, -180), list(59, 180)) )
),

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: ShinyMap: map displays but out of focus
parts:
Hi there. First off, you're using a deprecated API--the new, much cleaner API is documented here: http://rstudio.github.io/leaflet

The new API will automatically set the view to encompass whatever data is initially on the map.

If you'd rather stick with the deprecated API you're using, look at the leafletMap call, you're using the options argument to set the center of the map to 30.45, 28.
On Tue, Oct 20, 2015 at 8:09 AM Bee <ben.b...@gmail.com> wrote:

Also, I get a sense, from what I'm reading on setView() that it might work when you only have a few coordinate (lat/long) data to plot but how can you get that to work if you have a ton of coordinated data to locate on a map?
As I said in original post, my data displays on the NA region of the global map fine but it's out of focus

messages.subject: Re: ShinyMap: map displays but out of focus
parts:
Hey again,

I was a bit confused by the leafletMap syntax but after a quick check I think it is an outdated version of the leaflet package for R?!
So if Iam right I would recommend to take a look into

https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/shiny.html

An simply example for setting the above mentioned code would be

library(leaflet)
leaflet() %>%
      addTiles() %>%
      setView(lng=-118.243, lat=34.052, zoom = 8) #Los Angeles

Hope that helps.
